# FG-REVIEW-0009

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`merge-execution`](../../ops/runbooks/merge-execution.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_executing_merge_whose_ref_state_is_unknown_is_failed` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: マージの実行中に問題が起きました。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: A problem occurred while the merge was running. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Terjadi masalah saat merge dijalankan. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

The merge job could not finish a merge whose ref may have moved (ADR-0024 §4.2 steps 7, 9 and the reconciliation): reason=update_ref_failed (`git update-ref` failed although the target was still at `expected_old` and no `<ref>.lock` existed, or the ref could not be read back, or git timed out), record_failed (the ref moved and `forge.review.merge_applied` was logged, but the `merged` transaction failed), ref_state_unknown (the reconciliation found an `executing` attempt whose target is neither `new_sha` (or a descendant) nor `expected_old`: the attempt was set to `failed` for a person). For update_ref_failed and record_failed the attempt stays `executing`: the job's retry and the reconciliation (forge serve, every minute, after the update-ref timeout plus the grace) finish it by asking git.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Runbook merge-execution. The event carries `reason`, `merge_id`, `merge_request_id`, `repo_id`, `target`, `expected_old`, `new_sha`. Find the job's lines by its request_id; `forge.review.merge_applied` with the same `merge_id` means the ref moved. Read (read-only): SELECT id, state, reason, error_code, expected_old, new_sha, executing_at FROM forge.merge_request_merges WHERE id = <merge_id>; and the target tip: git --git-dir <repo> rev-parse <target>.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook merge-execution: never edit the row by hand. For record_failed / update_ref_failed wait for the reconciliation (it records `applied` when the tip is `new_sha` or its descendant, `superseded` when it is `expected_old`); for ref_state_unknown a person compares the tip with `new_sha` and decides (approved runbook step).
